summary: Nanobiotix S.A., a French foreign private issuer listed on Euronext Paris and Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K containing its monthly statutory disclosure of voting rights and share capital as of September 30, 2026. The release reports 50,967,610 shares outstanding, 54,729,543 theoretical voting rights and 54,707,425 exercisable voting rights, with the gap reflecting treasury shares with suspended voting rights. The disclosure is required under articles L.233-8 II of the French Commercial Code and AMF regulation 223-16, serving as the threshold-crossing reference. No transaction, board action or advisor is involved; a routine compliance notice with no risk-arb angle.
